lyrics:
[Intro: swampy guitar lick, deep kick, tambourine]

[Verse 1: smoky drawling female voice]
White stripe where the strap went
Ring of pale around my wrist
Little map of where I've been
Every place the sun got kissed

[Chorus: deep house beat, guitar answering]
Tan lines don't last
Gone by October, gone like that
Skin forgets, it always does
I'll remember what it was
Tan lines don't last
Good. I had it. Let it pass.

[Verse 2: voice lower, bass rolling]
You were here for seven days
Left a mark that's fading too
I don't need the proof to stay
To know the thing was true

[Chorus: deep house beat, guitar answering]
Tan lines don't last
Gone by October, gone like that
Skin forgets, it always does
I'll remember what it was
Tan lines don't last
Good. I had it. Let it pass.

[Guitar Break: slide guitar over kick and bass]

[Final Chorus: full groove, a low harmony]
Tan lines don't last
Gone by October, gone like that
Skin forgets, it always does
I'll remember what it was
Tan lines don't last
Good. I had it. Let it pass.

[Outro: guitar lick alone, cicadas]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 118 BPM, 4/4, E minor. A slow-burning, bluesy deep house groove, dusty and warm.

VOICE: Female, low, smoky and rough-edged, half-sung and half-drawled, lazy on the beat. A lower harmony of her own voice joins in the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A swampy, reverbed electric guitar playing a short blues lick, a slide guitar in the break, a deep, soft house kick, a rolling bass, tambourine and shaker, a dusty organ, handclaps with spring reverb.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar lick and kick. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:10 Verse 2. 1:36 Chorus 2. 2:04 Guitar break. 2:20 Final chorus. 2:48 Outro, guitar and cicadas, ends 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Blues recording on a deep house frame: voice and guitar raw, warm and slightly distorted, low end clean and round.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Good. I had it. Let it pass.' at 1:04.

STATION FIT: 8:30 p.m., the day over. A reflective, bluesy track that starts the evening without a synth in sight.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Noticing, rueful, accepting, glad.
